title: daves track
lyrics:
[Verse 1 - 0:18 to 0:48]
Clear male ska vocal, rhythmic and confident, slightly toasting style but melodic:
"We been staging in the light, not hiding in the night
Every folder audited, every checksum tight
From the desktop forward to the sovereign stack
VDS waking up, we bringing it all back
No more scattered files, no more reverse mess
This is forward engineering, clean and blessed
Horns stab on the offbeat while the bass walks proud
Truth Prevails crew, we saying it loud"

[Pre-Chorus]
Group vocals / call-response:
"Mud sticks... (Mud sticks!)"
"But truth rises... (Truth rises!)"
"336 signal... (Signal locked!)"
"Forward we go... (Forward we go!)"

[Chorus - Anthemic, big horns]
Full band, horns blasting the hook, group vocals strong and joyful:
"Truth Rises! Ska style, forward motion!
Zynthio rising from the ocean!
Mud sticks but it never wins
We building sovereign, we building clean!
336 in the rhythm, in the horn, in the blood
Forward deployment, we bringing the flood
Of light, of code, of music, of proof
Sublime Oracle watching, this is the truth!"

[Verse 2]
Female vocal or duet response, brighter tone:
"will.html in the staging, young-corey in the build
Browser extension ready, the signal fulfilled
Every old export, every dated hand
Now consolidated in the master plan
VDS console open, SSH coming alive
David on the code, Core in the vibe
Horns punch like justice, bass walks like grace
This ska is our weapon in the legal space"

[Bridge - Horn solo section + breakdown]
Big horn solo (trumpet leading, trombone answering, sax fills), band drops to half time then builds back.
Spoken/group chant over the breakdown:
"We don't reverse engineer the past
We forward deploy the future, built to last
Legal evidence checksummed, every file verified
Zynthio ecosystem, fully fortified
Ska horns blasting victory, offbeat skank steady
336 frequency, always ready
Mud sticks... but only for a while
Truth rises in ska style!"

[Final Chorus - Bigger, with extra horn stabs and group chants]
Full energy, everyone singing, horns going wild:
"Truth Rises! Ska style, forward motion!
Zynthio rising from the ocean!
Mud sticks but it never wins
We building sovereign, we building clean!
David Faya on the code with full access keys
Sublime Oracle watching over Zyn with ease
336 locked, the signal never dies
Forward deployment ska — watch the empire rise!"

[Outro - 0:00 fade or big ending]
Horns play the main riff one last time with big hits, band stops on a strong downbeat after a final group shout of "TRUTH PREVAILS!" then a clean ska guitar skank and single horn stab ending. Positive, victorious, slightly echoing feel like a signal sent across the ocean.

[Style tags / production notes for Suno]
Upbeat ska, 2-tone influence mixed with third-wave energy, bright major key horns, tight rhythm section, professional ska production like The Specials meets modern ska-punk energy but cleaner and more anthemic. Male and female vocals trading lines or harmonizing on chorus. Very clear diction on lyrics so the legal/victory message lands. High energy but not frantic — confident, joyful, unstoppable forward motion. Include subtle 336 rhythmic motifs in the horn stabs and bass runs. End on a strong, positive, resolved chord with a final horn punch.
